meta.question: Checking whether Healing Tempo's speed buff turns on when healing comes from Vampiric Burst's lifesteal, from a direct heal item, from passive bullet lifesteal, or from nothing.
meta.purpose: decides where Healing Tempo (a late, expensive item) belongs: 21 builds hold it, most of them pair it with lifesteal items whose heals may not count
meta.mechanics: item text (VERIFIED MECHANIC, citadel_mods_english.txt upgrade_healbuff_desc): applying healing grants fire rate and move speed; does not apply on innate regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals. Whether lifesteal granted by an active (Vampiric Burst, Infuser) counts as passive is not in the data (UNRESOLVED). Healing Nova is the positive control (a direct heal), passive Bullet Lifesteal the negative control (excluded by the text)
meta.prediction_D: positive control: a new self modifier (the Tempo buff) appears after the Healing Nova cast; its name is then the detector for the other arms. If none appears Healing Tempo does not trigger on self-cast heals at all and the file is read as INCONCLUSIVE for V
meta.prediction_P: negative control (text): no Tempo modifier after passive lifesteal hits
meta.prediction_V_counts: Tempo modifier appears while Vampiric Burst lifesteal heals: active-granted lifesteal counts
meta.prediction_V_not: no Tempo modifier: active-granted lifesteal is treated as passive
meta.decision_rule: V counts: Healing Tempo stays where Vampiric Burst or Infuser is the main heal. V not: Healing Tempo is only valuable with direct heals (Healing Nova, Rescue Beam, ally heals), builds owner reviews the builds in changes_builds that rely on lifesteal heals. D fails: INCONCLUSIVE, no change
meta.changes_builds: dynamo, kelvin, kelvin_support, haze, rem, solomon_support, victor, victor_gun, viscous, yamato, yamato_brawler, geist, geist_bomb, apollo, apollo_melee, celeste, celeste_carry, baba_tank, abrams, ivy, nurse
meta.unresolved_if: D shows no modifier (detector unproven); lowhp clamps health every frame, so a heal that is fully clamped may not register: if D fails repeat D at lowhp 30
meta.selection_reason: independent theorycraft: the item text names an exclusion (passive lifesteals) but not the active-granted case, and 21 builds pay for it
meta.alternative_reason: D and P are the positive and negative controls inside the file
meta.rotation: lowhp 50 in every block; active item cast first, then 1.5 s of gun fire; mods read after each step
meta.player_expect: Buff on a heal, or not
meta.result_says: WORKS if the Tempo buff appears during Vampiric Burst; DOES NOT WORK if it appears only after the Healing Nova
